run_rfdetr_naive_stream: run RTSP video stream inference with RF-DETR model to calculate object dwell time in configurable zones
load_rfdetr_model: load an RF-DETR model (nano, small, medium, base, or large) for a specified device and resolution
adjust_model_resolution: adjust input resolution to the nearest multiple of 32 or 56 based on the RF-DETR model size
create_polygon_zones: create polygon-based detection zones from a JSON configuration file for tracking object dwell time
track_detections_with_bytetrack: track object detections across video frames using ByteTrack with configurable matching threshold
